description: This file defines the DisabledInjectorService class, which extends SettingInjectorService and provides a service that reports a disabled state for an injected setting. It overrides methods to simulate delay and to indicate the setting is disabled.
external_methods: Log.e(String tag, String msg, Throwable tr)

classes.name: DisabledInjectorService
classes.description: A service class extending SettingInjectorService that simulates a disabled setting injector.

methods.name: DisabledInjectorService
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the service with its tag.

methods.name: onGetSummary
methods.description: Returns null after simulating a delay; overrides setting injector method to provide a summary.

methods.name: onGetEnabled
methods.description: Returns false indicating the setting is disabled.
